Hello,

I am applying for the Laboratory Technician in Training role with WSP's geotechnical laboratory team in Malaga. Preparing and testing soil, rock, aggregate and concrete samples under supervision, to the relevant standards in a NATA-accredited laboratory, is the technical work I want to build my career in.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, where my coursework applied AS 1726 and AS 1289 and covered earthworks and pavement systems. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), where I studied construction methods, structural principles and hydraulics.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer. I carried out site inspections and quality checks, and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. I hold a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence, and I work carefully with strong attention to detail.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
